notes: Round 59. Cuba and the two Azerbaijan records are flagged weak_source: Cuba's rests on BanknoteNews identifying the printer from the notes themselves rather than on any Banco Central de Cuba statement, and Azerbaijan's on an industry-body product profile rather than the bank. That matches how round 58's Mauritania record from the same industry body was treated. Madagascar is a substrate tie only -- the article names the substrate maker and not the printer -- so Madagascar still has no printer on the map.

records.detail: BanknoteNews records Goznak as the new printer of the Banco Central de Cuba's 200-peso note dated 2024 and of the 50-peso note dated 2025; the change is identified from the notes themselves rather than announced by the bank.
records.source_title: Cuba new printer 200-peso note (B916i) confirmed - BanknoteNews
records.quote: Like B916h, but new windowed security thread with demetalized BCC, new printer (Goznak), and serif s/n font.

records.detail: The International Association of Currency Affairs' per-note profile for the Central Bank of Azerbaijan's renewed 50-manat banknote lists G+D Currency Development GmbH as the printer.
records.source_title: Owner: Central Bank of Azerbaijan - 50 Manat - International Association of Currency Affairs

records.detail: The same IACA profile for the renewed 50-manat note lists Papierfabrik Louisenthal GmbH as the substrate supplier, a paper maker rather than the printer.
records.source_title: Owner: Central Bank of Azerbaijan - 50 Manat - International Association of Currency Affairs

records.detail: Central Banking reports the Banque Centrale de Madagascar's 20,000-ariary note is produced on Giesecke+Devrient's Louisenthal Hybrid substrate; this is the substrate maker, not the printer, which the article does not name.
records.source_title: Madagascar launches high-denomination banknote - Central Banking
records.quote: which is being printed on Giesecke and Devrient's (G&D) Louisenthal hybrid

records.detail: Haitian outlet iciHaiti reports the Banque de la Republique d'Haiti ordered a reprint of 30 million 10-gourde notes from Oberthur Fiduciaire S.A.S. for 845,000 euros; reported by a news outlet rather than announced by the bank.
records.source_title: iciHaiti - Economy: Reprint of 30 million of 10 Gourde banknotes
records.quote: has just placed an order for reprinting 30 million of 10 Gourdes notes to the French firm Oberthur Fiduciaire S.A.S.
